entries.76cc41b0ddacc268: This business plans, purchases and sells ladies' apparel and fashion goods. The company wholesales ladies' apparel and fashion goods. Its consolidated subsidiary S Kikaku Co., Ltd. wholesales apparel accessories and sales promotion materials and supplies some products to the company, and King Apparel Support Co., Ltd. provides outsourced planning, sales and clerical work, among other services. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,050 million.
entries.793a3d2776fe8dbf: This business model involves planning ladies’ apparel and other products in-house, purchasing them by commissioning production to trading companies and partner manufacturers, and wholesaling them to specialty stores and department stores, while also earning rental income from company-owned buildings.
entries.7c85343cdc4a006c: This business plans, purchases and sells ladies' apparel and fashion goods.
entries.940f1d292fc629f6: Under its basic policy of focusing on its core “fashion industry” business, its main apparel division concentrates on the better-up zone from “Career” to “Mrs.” customers, provides high-quality, high-sensitivity products and appropriate in-store presentation and services to raise brand loyalty, and focuses on shop development and brand development to secure an advantage in competition among brands; in parallel, it aims for stable growth through rationalizing production costs and using overheads efficiently. This is the basis of its management strategy. As issues to address, the Apparel Business will work on rebranding, strengthening product competitiveness and developing new brands; the Textile Business will deepen existing businesses and develop new sales channels; and the Estate Business will advance property development and other initiatives.

entries.a16a274c72987963: As an effective use of the company's own real estate, this business mainly leases office buildings and similar properties. The company leases part of each of its Tokyo head office, Osaka store and Kyoto main store buildings, as well as rental real estate in Minato-ku, Tokyo, to parties outside the consolidated group. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,015 million.
